identity: A UW draw-go control deck that answers permanently rather than temporarily. Twelve of its twenty-two nonland cards interact, and every mass answer is asymmetric by construction: Temporary Lockdown exiles all nonland permanents of mana value 2 or less, and 0 of this list's 11 nonland permanents sit at or below that line. Once the board is stripped, five evasive fliers totalling 17 power in the air convert an empty battlefield into a two-to-three swing clock. It wins by making the opponent's board disappear into exile - where this cube's 32 graveyard-interaction cards cannot reach it - and then flying over the wreckage.

sideboard.name: Impede Momentum
sideboard.oracle_text:
Tap target creature and put three stun counters on it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
sideboard.when_to_board: In vs a single large threat I cannot destroy (Tyrannical Pitlord 6/6, Writhing Necromass 5/5): three stun counters take it off the table for three untap steps, and it supplies the tapped-creature condition Artillery Blast and Runic Shot both require.

Doce de sus veintidós cartas no-tierra interactúan, y cada respuesta masiva es asimétrica por construcción: Temporary Lockdown exilia todos los permanentes que no sean tierra de valor de maná 2 o menos, y 0 de los 11 permanentes no-tierra de esta lista están en esa línea o por debajo. Una vez despojado el tablero, cinco voladores evasivos que suman 17 de fuerza en el aire convierten un campo de batalla vacío en un reloj de dos o tres golpes. Gana haciendo que el tablero del rival desaparezca en el exilio — donde las 32 cartas de interacción con el cementerio de este cubo no pueden alcanzarlo — y luego volando por encima de los restos.
